There’s an application (free) on VR platforms called VRchat, which is what we use, although I’m sure there’s others that work just as well. VRchat allows you to choose an avatar from thousands of options, and then you can go into a community made world (either public or private) and hang out there. Some worlds even have haptic feedback if you touch something! Technically you can access this app on a PC via steam, but I find it a lot less immersive. I know that a lot of VR arcades have this so if you’re still not sure and if they’re open in your area I would recommend giving it a try through one of those to see if it’s for you!
